## Deferred / limits

EHands retained as preprint; no reliable subsequent journal record was established. Older CVs are historical, not the authoritative current professional record.

Phase 5 must validate the exact full-clone Jekyll build, all historical download paths, cross-browser accessibility, native zoom, keyboard and responsive layout, links, and release diff. No stylesheet, navigation, workflow, configuration, or legacy asset changes in this patch. Maintain all development-branch safeguards in AGENTS.md. Do not push or deploy without explicit approval.
